# ASIC driver snapshot

`bm13xx-rs/` is an unmodified extraction of the user-supplied `bm13xx-rs-main.zip`.
SHA-256 of the input ZIP: `746318917fa1bcead055d50c6ff291f1cda98516affe8bc444a1c6bf13b3bd7d`.

All ASIC dependencies use this local workspace, so BM1370, BM1366, BM1397, the chain and the protocol share the same source snapshot. No sibling checkout is required. The original MIT and Apache-2.0 licenses are retained in that directory.
